pandas.testing.assert_series_equal

pandas 3.1.1 · Testing, errors, and warnings · function

Compare two Series in a test, including their values, labels and configured metadata checks.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.testing.assert_series_equal(…) Full signature
pd.testing.assert_series_equal(
    left,
    right,
    check_dtype=True,
    check_index_type='equiv',
    check_series_type=True,
    check_names=True,
    check_exact=…,
    check_datetimelike_compat=False,
    check_categorical=True,
    check_category_order=True,
    check_freq=…,
    check_flags=True,
    rtol=…,
    atol=…,
    obj='Series',
    *,
    check_index=True,
    check_like=False,
)
